entries.original_english:
"Hello, Trainer.

Wait\.

Can it be\.

Are you the [buffer2] of the
legendary Trainer, [green]Aros[blue]?"
entries.tendency_suggestion: 丁寧で驚きを抑えた呼びかけ。『Wait.』『Can it be.』の間を保つ

entries.original_english:
"You are his [buffer2]!

I knew my eyesight was not
deceiving me!

Your father was, to put it simply,
an amazing man.

I’m sure if you introduced yourself
to people as his [buffer2], you\lwould instantly be regarded with\lmuch affection.

There aren’t many people out there
who have not heard of his exploits.

It’s a shame he disappeared.

If only someone knew what happened
to him, I would finally have a\lsense of closure."
entries.tendency_suggestion: 敬意をもって興奮気味に話す。父(Aros)を称える調子

entries.original_english:
"Whoa, [buffer3]\.

Welcome to the Soil.

Feel free to make yourself at home
as long as you want, [buffer3].

Take in all the good air\."
entries.tendency_suggestion: くつろいだ歓迎。ゆったり落ち着かせる言い方

entries.original_english:
"Wingderful!

For today, I’d like to see the
beautiful wings of a [green][buffer1][blue]."
entries.tendency_suggestion: 駄洒落(Wingderful)好きの明るい依頼人

entries.original_english:
"No\.

I need an experienced Trainer who’s
proven themself by defeating the\lElite 4 for my task."
entries.tendency_suggestion: 丁寧で威厳のある依頼人。同じマップの近接オブジェクトだが同一NPCとは未確定

entries.original_english:
"Ah, if it isn’t the Champion of the
Borrius region!

I have just the request for someone
of your skill level.

Would you like to hear it?"
entries.tendency_suggestion: 丁寧で威厳のある依頼人(同上)

entries.original_english:
"The task is simple: train a
[green]Butterfree[blue] to Level [green]70[blue] and\lpresent it to me.

It can be over Level 70, but it
must be at least that.

Once you’ve done that, I’ll inform
you of the next part of the task."
entries.tendency_suggestion: 要点を整えて説明する依頼人(同上)

entries.original_english:
"Have you brought me a
Level [green]70 Butterfree[blue]?"
entries.tendency_suggestion: 確認を促す短い問いかけ(同上)

entries.original_english:
"Come here, kid, quietly.

Our whole region is secretly
controlled by the bourgeoisie\land the capitalists.

We in the working class have to
band together and rise up against\lthem in the name of communism!

Their weakness is free services.

If you heal at a Pokémon Center
enough times, their machine of\loppression will crumble."
entries.tendency_suggestion: ひそひそ声の陰謀論者(コミカル)

entries.original_english:
"Workers of the world unite!

All you need to do is heal [green][buffer1][red]
times at any Pokémon Center.

Other than the one in Antisis City,
they’re all in on the revolution."
entries.tendency_suggestion: スローガンを叫ぶ陰謀論者(コミカル)

entries.original_english:
"Shush, quiet.

Did you know that the Borrius
region is secretly governed by a\lcommunist consortium, that does\lcommunist things?

We can fight the power by you
buying enough unregistered goods\lfrom Poké Marts.

All Poké Marts are in on it.
You up for a capitalist revolution?"
entries.tendency_suggestion: 『Shush, quiet.』と声を潜める陰謀論者(コミカル)

entries.original_english:
"Long live the revolution!

If you make [green][buffer1][red] purchases from
Poké Marts, the communist system\lwill collapse, and our capitalist\lrevolution can begin."
entries.tendency_suggestion: 革命を叫ぶ誇張した調子(コミカル)

entries.original_english:
"Pokémon are evolutionarily
superior to people.

But as a consequence of this, they
have started to overpopulate.

We need to lower their wild
population before they realize that\lthey have the upper hand over us.

Can you catch [green][buffer1][blue] Pokémon outside
of the Safari Zone in one day to\lslow their growth rate?"
entries.tendency_suggestion: 進化論的優越を語る冷静だが不穏な語り口

entries.original_english:
"I am the Trash-Man!

I live in trash!
I eat trash!

Don’t ask, that’s what I do.

I am not looking for garbage, I am
looking for the classiest pieces of\ltrash, but this requires effort.

I would rather pay you to do it
for me.

Will you search trash cans for me
to find at least [green][buffer1][blue] items?"
entries.tendency_suggestion: 自分をTrash-Manと名乗る奇矯で誇らしげな宣言(本文中に自己紹介あり)

entries.original_english:
"I believe that Arceus creates all
Pokémon, but I am also a woman of\lscience.

I am trying to figure out whether
religion or science is right.

I believe Pokémon evolution holds
the key to the answer.

Care to help?
I need [green][buffer1][red] observations."
entries.tendency_suggestion: 『woman of science』と本文で自称する、丁寧で内省的な話し方。性別の手がかりは本文の自称のみ

entries.original_english:
"Excellent, I will need you to view
[green][buffer1][red] Pokémon evolutions, and report\lyour unbiased opinion."
entries.tendency_suggestion: 依頼の説明を丁寧に行う科学者的な調子

entries.original_english:
"Wow, you’re done!
Now, let’s look at the data.

\.

It says that there are both
scientific and religious facets to\lPokémon evolution.

Perhaps Arceus is more involved
than we know\.

Interesting, please take this
Pokémon as my thanks."
entries.tendency_suggestion: 結果を総括するやや芝居がかった調子

entries.original_english:
"Then, demonstrate your hunger for
true wealth to me.

To become truly wealthy, have your
Pokémon earn [green][buffer1][red] Exp. Points\lin total within a single day."
entries.tendency_suggestion: 富への飢えを問う儀式的でもったいぶった調子

buy [green]Ultra Balls[red]!

They’re way better at catching
Pokémon than Great Balls."
entries.tendency_suggestion: 商品の情報を伝える親切な説明口調

I’ve already collected seven jars,

I heard they could be found on wild
Combee, but I’m not having much\lluck finding them.

Are you able to find [green]3[red] Combee

\.

\.

mistake.

rules: キャラ付けしない。誰かの口調を借りない
